scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:6200 && pnpm run build:electron && node scripts/dev-electron.js
scripts.build: pnpm run build:vite && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @tagger/desktop exec electron-builder --projectDir ../..
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @tagger/desktop exec electron-builder --projectDir ../.. --mac
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @tagger/desktop exec electron-builder --projectDir ../.. --win
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @tagger/desktop exec electron-builder --projectDir ../.. --linux
scripts.test: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:server && pnpm --filter @tagger/server run bundle && node --test scripts/*.test.cjs
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:server && concurrently "node apps/server/dist/index.js" "pnpm --filter @tagger/ui dev"
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:vite && pnpm run build:server
scripts.bundle:server: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @tagger/server run bundle
